definition: used to add a contrasting point to what you just said
example: We wanted to launch on Friday. However, the tests failed.
exampleEs: Queríamos lanzar el viernes. Sin embargo, fallaron las pruebas.
cloze: We wanted to launch on Friday. ____, the tests failed.
note: Put a comma after it at the start of a sentence. Use a period or semicolon before it, not a comma.

definition: used to compare two things that are different
example: Our old tool is slow, whereas the new one responds instantly.
exampleEs: Nuestra herramienta antigua es lenta, mientras que la nueva responde al instante.
cloze: Our old tool is slow, ____ the new one responds instantly.
note: Formal contrast. It joins two clauses, so both sides need a subject and a verb.

definition: used to introduce a fact that is surprising or contrasts with the main clause
example: Although I was tired, I stayed for the whole meeting.
exampleEs: Aunque estaba cansado, me quedé toda la reunión.
cloze: ____ I was tired, I stayed for the whole meeting.
note: Do not add 'but' in the same sentence: 'Although I was tired, but I stayed' is wrong.

definition: used to say that something happened even though something else made it difficult
example: Despite the time difference, we managed to join the call.
exampleEs: A pesar de la diferencia horaria, logramos conectarnos a la llamada.
cloze: ____ the time difference, we managed to join the call.
note: No 'of' after it: 'despite', not 'despite of'. It is followed by a noun or -ing, not a full clause.

definition: used to introduce a different or opposite point of view
example: Remote work saves time. On the other hand, it can feel isolating.
exampleEs: El trabajo remoto ahorra tiempo. Por otro lado, puede sentirse aislante.
cloze: Remote work saves time. ____, it can feel isolating.
note: Often paired with 'on the one hand'. Do not say 'in the other hand'.

definition: used to introduce the consequence of something
example: The server crashed. As a result, users could not log in.
exampleEs: El servidor se cayó. Como resultado, los usuarios no pudieron iniciar sesión.
cloze: The server crashed. ____, users could not log in.
note: 'As a result of' + noun means 'because of'. 'As a result,' alone starts a new sentence.

definition: used to add another piece of information
example: We need to fix the login bug. In addition, we need to update the documentation.
exampleEs: Necesitamos arreglar el error de inicio de sesión. Además, necesitamos actualizar la documentación.
cloze: We need to fix the login bug. ____, we need to update the documentation.
note: 'In addition to' is followed by a noun or -ing: 'in addition to working late'.

definition: used to introduce a point that softens or contrasts with what you just said
example: The plan is risky. That said, it could double our users.
exampleEs: El plan es arriesgado. Dicho esto, podría duplicar nuestros usuarios.
cloze: The plan is risky. ____, it could double our users.
note: Very common in meetings and informal writing. Short and natural.

definition: used to add a contrasting idea after you have agreed with or accepted something
example: I agree with your proposal. Having said that, I have one concern.
exampleEs: Estoy de acuerdo con tu propuesta. Dicho eso, tengo una preocupación.
cloze: I agree with your proposal. ____, I have one concern.
note: Slightly more formal than 'that said'. Say it as one smooth chunk.

definition: used to say the same thing again in a simpler or clearer way
example: The project is behind schedule. In other words, we will miss the deadline.
exampleEs: El proyecto va retrasado. En otras palabras, no cumpliremos la fecha límite.
cloze: The project is behind schedule. ____, we will miss the deadline.
collocations: to put it in other words
note: Great for clarifying in meetings when someone looks confused.

definition: used before a short summary of the main points
example: We discussed cost, scope, and timing. To sum up, we need more time, a bigger budget, and a clearer scope.
exampleEs: Hablamos de costo, alcance y plazos. Para resumir, necesitamos más tiempo, un presupuesto mayor y un alcance más claro.
cloze: We discussed cost, scope, and timing. ____, we need more time, a bigger budget, and a clearer scope.
note: You can also say 'to sum it up' or 'in summary'. Use it at the end of your answer.

definition: used to say what happens at the same time or in the period between two events
example: The data is still loading. Meanwhile, you can review the report.
exampleEs: Los datos aún se están cargando. Mientras tanto, puedes revisar el informe.
cloze: The data is still loading. ____, you can review the report.
note: Similar to 'in the meantime'. Do not confuse with 'mean time'.

definition: used to say what would happen if something does not happen
example: Back up your files today. Otherwise, you could lose everything.
exampleEs: Haz una copia de seguridad hoy. De lo contrario, podrías perderlo todo.
cloze: Back up your files today. ____, you could lose everything.
note: It means 'if not', so it does not need a separate 'if'.

definition: used to say that something is true or happens despite what was just said
example: The results were disappointing. Nevertheless, the team stayed positive.
exampleEs: Los resultados fueron decepcionantes. No obstante, el equipo se mantuvo positivo.
cloze: The results were disappointing. ____, the team stayed positive.
note: Formal. Spell it as one word: never-the-less.

es: dado que, teniendo en cuenta que
definition: used to introduce a fact that explains or supports your next statement
example: Given that the budget is fixed, we should cut some features.
exampleEs: Dado que el presupuesto es fijo, deberíamos recortar algunas funciones.
cloze: ____ the budget is fixed, we should cut some features.
note: Followed by a full clause. Without 'that', 'given' takes a noun: 'given the budget'.

definition: used to show that something is a logical result of what you just said
example: The sample size was small. Therefore, the results may not be reliable.
exampleEs: La muestra fue pequeña. Por lo tanto, los resultados podrían no ser confiables.
cloze: The sample size was small. ____, the results may not be reliable.
note: More formal than 'so'. Good for writing and presentations.

definition: used to add a stronger or more important point to what you just said
example: The tool is cheap. Moreover, it integrates with everything we use.
exampleEs: La herramienta es barata. Además, se integra con todo lo que usamos.
cloze: The tool is cheap. ____, it integrates with everything we use.
note: Formal. In speech, prefer 'plus' or 'and also'.

definition: used to add extra information that supports your argument
example: The plan is affordable. Furthermore, it is easy to maintain.
exampleEs: El plan es económico. Asimismo, es fácil de mantener.
cloze: The plan is affordable. ____, it is easy to maintain.
note: Formal writing. Do not overuse it; one per paragraph is plenty.

definition: used to say that something happened although something else made it hard
example: In spite of the delay, the client was happy.
exampleEs: A pesar del retraso, el cliente estaba contento.
cloze: ____ the delay, the client was happy.
collocations: in spite of the fact that
note: Same meaning as 'despite'. Always three words: 'in spite of', never 'in spite'.

definition: a stronger form of 'although', used for a surprising fact
example: Even though it was midnight, he kept debugging.
exampleEs: Aunque era medianoche, él siguió depurando.
cloze: ____ it was midnight, he kept debugging.
note: Stronger than 'although'. Never write 'even' alone for this: 'even I was tired' means something else.

definition: used to contrast two ideas or to say two things happen at the same time
example: While some users love the feature, others find it confusing.
exampleEs: Mientras que a algunos usuarios les encanta la función, otros la encuentran confusa.
cloze: ____ some users love the feature, others find it confusing.
note: Can mean 'whereas' (contrast) or 'during the time that'. Context tells you which.

definition: used to say something is true only if another thing does not happen
example: We will ship on Monday unless the tests fail.
exampleEs: Lanzaremos el lunes a menos que fallen las pruebas.
cloze: We will ship on Monday ____ the tests fail.
note: It already means 'if not', so do not add 'not': 'unless it rains', not 'unless it does not rain'.

es: siempre que, con la condición de que
definition: used to say that something will happen only if a condition is met
example: You can use my laptop, provided that you back up your files.
exampleEs: Puedes usar mi laptop, siempre que respaldes tus archivos.
cloze: You can use my laptop, ____ you back up your files.
note: Also 'providing that' or just 'provided'. Common in contracts and rules.

es: por si acaso, en caso de que
definition: used to say you do something as a precaution for a possible future event
example: Take a charger with you in case the battery dies.
exampleEs: Lleva un cargador por si se acaba la batería.
cloze: Take a charger with you ____ the battery dies.
note: False friend with 'en caso de que' as 'if'. 'In case' = as a precaution, not 'if'.

definition: used to say the purpose of an action
example: I wrote the steps down so that everyone can follow them.
exampleEs: Anoté los pasos para que todos puedan seguirlos.
cloze: I wrote the steps down ____ everyone can follow them.
note: For a purpose with a new subject, use 'so that', not 'for' or 'to': 'so that you can', not 'for you can'.

definition: used to say something is true or allowed only under a condition
example: You can work from home as long as you attend the weekly meeting.
exampleEs: Puedes trabajar desde casa siempre y cuando asistas a la reunión semanal.
cloze: You can work from home ____ you attend the weekly meeting.
note: Common and natural in speech. Same idea as 'provided that', but less formal.

definition: used to introduce a result of what was just said
example: The company missed its targets. Consequently, the team was restructured.
exampleEs: La empresa no alcanzó sus metas. En consecuencia, se reestructuró el equipo.
cloze: The company missed its targets. ____, the team was restructured.
note: Formal. Do not confuse with 'subsequently' (= later, afterward).

es: así, de este modo, por lo tanto
definition: used to show a result or a way something is done
example: The model was trained on more data and thus became more accurate.
exampleEs: El modelo se entrenó con más datos y así se volvió más preciso.
cloze: The model was trained on more data and ____ became more accurate.
note: Formal and short. 'Thus far' means 'until now'.

definition: used to introduce an example
example: Many tools can help. For instance, Notion is great for notes.
exampleEs: Muchas herramientas pueden ayudar. Por ejemplo, Notion es excelente para notas.
cloze: Many tools can help. ____, Notion is great for notes.
note: Same as 'for example'. Use a comma after it.

definition: used to point out one especially important thing from a group
example: I like sci-fi, in particular stories about artificial intelligence.
exampleEs: Me gusta la ciencia ficción, en particular las historias sobre inteligencia artificial.
cloze: I like sci-fi, ____ stories about artificial intelligence.
note: Do not say 'in special'. The word is 'particular'.

definition: used to say that the opposite of what was just said is true
example: The update did not slow the app down. On the contrary, it made it faster.
exampleEs: La actualización no hizo más lenta la app. Al contrario, la hizo más rápida.
cloze: The update did not slow the app down. ____, it made it faster.
note: Use it to correct a negative statement. For a simple difference, use 'on the other hand'.

definition: used to compare two things that are very different
example: Sales in Mexico grew fast. By contrast, sales in Spain stayed flat.
exampleEs: Las ventas en México crecieron rápido. En cambio, las ventas en España se mantuvieron estables.
cloze: Sales in Mexico grew fast. ____, sales in Spain stayed flat.
note: Also 'in contrast'. Use it to compare two facts, not to correct an idea.

definition: used to say that something is like what you just mentioned
example: Python is popular for data science. Similarly, JavaScript dominates web development.
exampleEs: Python es popular para ciencia de datos. De manera similar, JavaScript domina el desarrollo web.
cloze: Python is popular for data science. ____, JavaScript dominates web development.
note: Goes at the start of the second sentence to show a parallel.

definition: used to say that something is also true or should be done in the same way
example: I always give feedback politely, and I expect my team to do likewise.
exampleEs: Siempre doy retroalimentación con cortesía y espero que mi equipo haga lo mismo.
cloze: I always give feedback politely, and I expect my team to do ____.
note: Often replaces 'the same' after a verb: 'do likewise'. Also a polite reply: 'Nice to meet you.' 'Likewise.'

definition: used to say that something replaces another thing
example: The meeting was cancelled. Let's chat on Slack instead.
exampleEs: La reunión se canceló. Mejor charlemos por Slack.
cloze: The meeting was cancelled. Let's chat on Slack ____.
note: 'Instead' goes alone, usually at the end. 'Instead of' is followed by a noun or -ing.

definition: used to say what happens during the time before something else happens
example: The release is next week. In the meantime, please keep testing.
exampleEs: El lanzamiento es la próxima semana. Mientras tanto, por favor sigan probando.
cloze: The release is next week. ____, please keep testing.
note: Always 'the': 'in the meantime', not 'in meantime'.

es: en primer lugar, antes que nada
definition: used to introduce the first point in a list or the first thing you want to say
example: First of all, I want to thank everyone for joining. Second, I will share the agenda.
exampleEs: Antes que nada, quiero agradecer a todos por unirse. Segundo, compartiré la agenda.
cloze: ____, I want to thank everyone for joining. Second, I will share the agenda.
note: Great opening for a presentation. Next ones: 'second', 'then', 'finally'.

definition: used to say something happens later than the event you just mentioned
example: We finished the demo, and afterwards we had lunch.
exampleEs: Terminamos la demo y después almorzamos.
cloze: We finished the demo, and ____ we had lunch.
note: In US English 'afterward' is also common. Do not confuse with 'after' + noun.

definition: used to say that something happens after a long time or many problems
example: After many failed attempts, we eventually fixed the bug.
exampleEs: Después de muchos intentos fallidos, finalmente arreglamos el error.
cloze: After many failed attempts, we ____ fixed the bug.
note: False friend: it does not mean 'eventualmente' (possibly). It means 'in the end'.

definition: used to introduce the final point or summary of a talk or text
example: In conclusion, the new process saves time and reduces errors.
exampleEs: En conclusión, el nuevo proceso ahorra tiempo y reduce errores.
cloze: ____, the new process saves time and reduces errors.
note: Formal. For speaking, 'to wrap up' sounds more natural.

definition: used to give an overall judgment after considering everything
example: All in all, the launch went better than we expected.
exampleEs: En general, el lanzamiento salió mejor de lo que esperábamos.
cloze: ____, the launch went better than we expected.
note: Informal and friendly. Good for opinions and reviews.

definition: used to add a surprising or stronger detail that supports your point
example: I like remote meetings. In fact, I prefer them to office ones.
exampleEs: Me gustan las reuniones remotas. De hecho, las prefiero a las de oficina.
cloze: I like remote meetings. ____, I prefer them to office ones.
note: Do not translate as 'actually' only. 'In fact' adds emphasis to a true detail.

definition: used to introduce a true detail, often one that is surprising or corrects someone
example: Do I know her? As a matter of fact, she was my manager.
exampleEs: ¿La conozco? De hecho, fue mi jefa.
cloze: Do I know her? ____, she was my manager.
collocations: as a matter of fact, I
as a matter of fact, it
note: Sounds a bit more formal than 'in fact'. Often used to gently correct someone.

definition: used to add one more reason, often a stronger one
example: I don't have time for that project. Besides, nobody asked for it.
exampleEs: No tengo tiempo para ese proyecto. Además, nadie lo pidió.
cloze: I don't have time for that project. ____, nobody asked for it.
note: Different from 'beside' (= next to). Add the final -s: 'besides' = 'also'.

definition: used to give the cause of something, followed by a noun
example: The call was postponed owing to technical problems.
exampleEs: La llamada se pospuso debido a problemas técnicos.
cloze: The call was postponed ____ technical problems.
note: Formal. Followed by a noun, not a full clause.

definition: used to show the cause of something, followed by a noun
example: The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
exampleEs: El vuelo se retrasó debido al mal clima.
cloze: The flight was delayed ____ bad weather.
note: Followed by a noun phrase. For a full clause use 'because'.

definition: used to give a reason that the listener already knows
example: Since you're already here, can you help me with this bug?
exampleEs: Ya que estás aquí, ¿me puedes ayudar con este error?
cloze: ____ you're already here, can you help me with this bug?
note: Two meanings: reason ('since you asked') and time ('since 2020'). The reason meaning starts a sentence often.

definition: used to say the purpose of an action
example: In order to improve my English, I practice every day.
exampleEs: Para mejorar mi inglés, practico todos los días.
cloze: ____ improve my English, I practice every day.
note: Followed by the base verb. For a negative purpose: 'in order not to forget'.

definition: used to add something extra, often another problem or benefit
example: The bug broke the login. On top of that, it deleted some data.
exampleEs: El error rompió el inicio de sesión. Además de eso, borró algunos datos.
cloze: The bug broke the login. ____, it deleted some data.
note: Informal and spoken. Often adds a second problem.

definition: used to return to the main topic or to say something is true in spite of the situation
example: Anyway, let's get back to the agenda.
exampleEs: En fin, volvamos a la agenda.
cloze: ____, let's get back to the agenda.
note: Write it as one word. 'Any way' (two words) means 'any method'.
